question: amasai, mahath and elkanah-4 are each recorded as an ancestor of the other: a cycle.

actions.why: The genealogical Mahath son of amasai in 1CH 6:35 belongs to rows 98756, 101045 and 101046; the Mahath son of amasai-3 in Hezekiah's reign belongs to row 105602. Separate these namesakes while leaving protected row 107213 unchanged.

note: The cycle comes from protected row 107213: 1CH 6:35 makes elkanah-5 the son of Mahath, whereas the continuing Hebrew chain in 6:36 makes elkanah-4 the father of Amasai. That owner ruling must remain untouched, so splitting the two Mahaths will not itself remove the cycle.
